title: Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration
summary: Structured clinical decisions from volumetric computed tomography (CT) require anatomically grounded predictions and calibrated confidence estimates. However, existing 3D medical multimodal models often suffer from uncalibrated autoregressive decoding and shortcut reliance on irrelevant anatomical regions.
